title: SE implementation scratchpad - Blue Crest Finance
content:
Context / goal:
- Blue Crest Finance (BCF) wants Redwood Dedicated behind VPC with KMS integration, per-region data residency (US East + EU West), and predictable latency < 120ms (95th for 2k token requests).
- Pilot: customer-facing chatbot + internal doc search (embeddings) for 6 internal queues, ~50 qps peak across features.

Meeting notes (2025-11-13 sync with Jordan / BCF infra):
- Customer currently on GCP (us-east1 + europe-west4). They need Private networking (VPC peering / VPN), and a strict egress policy (no public internet from inference nodes).
- KMS requirement: HSM-backed keys, rotation policy every 90 days.
- Compliance: logs must be retained 1 year (audit team).
- Timeline: pilot kickoff in 4 weeks, production in 12 weeks if pilot passes perf/security checks.

Immediate action items (my TODOs):
- [ ] Draft pilot infra diagram and send to BCF infra (due 2025-11-17).
- [ ] Validate KMS/HSM compatibility with Redwood Private (reach out to security for HSM adapter details) (due 2025-11-18).
- [ ] Run cost/throughput estimate for expected 50 qps (embedding + chat mix). Use current model suggestions (redwood-3b-quant) and dedicated instance sizing.
- [ ] Prepare prompt + eval set for chat and doc search (get sample docs from BCF).
- [ ] Add Jira ticket ENG-8421 for Dedicated cluster provisioning + VPC peering.

Config notes / recommendations (draft to share):
- Model selection:
  - Chat: redwood-3b-quant (FP16/INT8 fallback) for cost/latency tradeoff. If QA shows hallucination/regression, escalate to redwood-7b-quant for chat.
  - Embeddings: use redwood-embed-1 (dedicated instance for pooling).
- Dedicated sizing estimate (initial pilot):
  - 2 x A100-80GB equiv nodes for model serving (can autoscale to 4 for bursts).
  - Redis KV cache for prefix caching (single shard with HA).
  - Batch size suggestions: chat: dynamic batching target 2-4, max latency 120ms. Embeddings: batch up to 64 (throughput oriented).
- Networking:
  - VPC peering + private DNS. Configure nodes with no default route to internet; use NAT only for updates (controlled).
  - Ports: 443 only to customer-controlled LB; SSH access restricted via bastion.
- Security/KMS:
  - Use provided HSM-backed key; need PKCS#11 adapter details. Action: get contact at BCF security for HSM vendor and test key (Jordan to share).
  - Audit logs: enable verbose request logs but redact tokens; store to GCS bucket in customer project via service account.

Quick dev commands / checklist for pilot cluster (ops notes):
- Provision nodes (internal ticket to infra): reference ENG-8421
- Example terraform snippet notes (not final):
  - set variable private_network = true
  - provide kms_key_id = "projects/PROJECT/locations/global/keyRings/BCF/cryptoKeys/rc-api-key"
- Test curl to internal endpoint (once peering up):
  curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://private-api.bluecrest.example/v1/generate

Evaluation plan (pilot pass criteria):
- Latency: 95th < 120ms for chat at 2k tokens (profile with locust + real prompt distribution).
- Cost: pilot should show < $0.011 per chat request (estimate) — need exact calc from Optimize team.
- Quality: no regression on top-50 prompt set compared to hosted baseline (use eval harness).

Open questions / blockers:
- HSM integration: do they allow remote HSM connection or will we need on-prem HSM? (blocks KMS plan)
- Data residency: can we host logging GCS bucket in customer project in EU region for EU users? Legal approves?
- SSO: BCF wants SAML SSO for Redwood Console on pilot. Need product/identity to confirm timeline.

Notes to self / scratch ideas:
- Consider recommending model-routing policy: prefer EU-region small models for EU traffic to satisfy residency and lower latency.
- For cost reduction, propose a cache-first pattern for FAQ-like queries (hash-based prefix cache).
- Add a canary route in rollout: 10% traffic to quantized model, measure regressions for 48 hours, then expand.

Next meetings:
- 2025-11-18: security deep-dive (Jordan + BCF security).
- 2025-11-20: infra handoff + infra ticket triage (Priya, infra).

Quick links (placeholders to replace with real artifacts):
- Jira ENG-8421 (cluster provisioning)
- Confluence: Blue Crest Onboarding (draft)
- GH PR: infra/pull/719 (vpc peering helpers)

Last quick log (2026-02-25):
- Followed up with BCF on HSM vendor (Thales) — customer says they can provide remote HSM endpoints. Security ok to proceed with PKCS#11 test.
- Performance run scheduled next week; need to finalize prompt set today.
quick_summary: Personal SE scratchpad for Blue Crest Finance pilot: action items, infra suggestions, security/KMS questions, and evaluation plan.
